g.text: Three real, already-costed global tax levers

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #7a2e2e
font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: All figures are WORLDWIDE annual revenue in US dollars, accruing to the jurisdictions where the profit or the taxpayer sits.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: A coalition collects its own share, not the total. OECD global minimum tax (Pillar Two, 15% corporate floor): $108.5B is the actual

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: 2024 realised revenue (OECD, reported €79–109bn / $91–126bn) — well below the original $155–192B/yr projection, shown here as the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: aggressive case; a real example of projected vs. realised tax revenue diverging. Billionaire and centimillionaire minimum-wealth

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: taxes: Gabriel Zucman / EU Tax Observatory report to the G20 (June 2024) — 2% of wealth from ~3,000 billionaires ($200–250B/yr),

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: plus an estimated $100–140B/yr extending the same standard to ~centimillionaires. None of these three measures is currently in

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: force globally; each requires multilateral coordination this document does not assume will happen.
